review.draftParagraph: We do not consider the decline defensible on the current evidence. Storm conditions are established: peak gusts of 61 mph at the nearest station on 9 December 2025 (Storm Bram) exceed the wording's 55 mph guide, and displaced ridge tiles with water ingress are storm-consistent. The insurer relies on mortar deterioration but has not discharged its burden: the photos are undated, taken from the ground, and none shows the mortar bed failing before the event. A dated close-up of pre-existing mortar failure would change this. Emergency or temporary repair costs are likely payable.
